- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30, 14:30-15:00
- Friday: 11:00-12:00

Could you check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars and let me know which of these slots work for them? Priority on the longer windows (Mon 9-10, Tue 13-14, Wed 15-16, Fri 11-12).
